title: VZ Skills project configuration (version 1)
description: Contents of .vz-skills/config.json (project) or ~/.vz-skills/config.json (user). Generated from scripts/lib/config.js by scripts/gen-config-schema.js; do not edit by hand. All keys are optional; unknown keys are rejected by the resolver.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON Schema, for editor support. Ignored by the resolver.

$comment.description: Free-text comment. Ignored by the resolver.

version.description: Config schema version. Only 1 is supported.

profile.description: Rigor profile. Sets presets for every other key; explicit keys override presets.

depth.description: How much planning detail the plan skill produces.

plan_when.description: When a written plan is required before implementation, by change risk tier. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "risk>=low".

ambiguity_tolerance.description: low = ask about any ambiguity that changes the design; high = proceed on sensible assumptions and state them.

ask_before_implementing.description: Whether acceptance criteria must be confirmed with the user before implementing.

strategy.description: targeted = tests for changed units; affected = plus tests that import them; full = whole suite. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "affected".

require_baseline.description: Run (allowlisted) baseline tests before changing code so pre-existing failures are recorded.

tdd.description: Write the failing test first for new behaviour.

require_new_tests_for_new_behavior.description: New behaviour without a test is reported as NOT VERIFIED.

depth.description: Self-review depth before reporting completion. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "standard".

independent_reviewer.description: Delegate a fresh-context review to the independent-reviewer agent.

review_trigger.description: When the security-review skill runs. Safety floor: "sensitive-paths"; lowering it requires listing this key in safety.acknowledged_overrides. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "material-changes".

threat_model_on_production.description: Produce a short threat model for PRODUCTION-profile changes that touch trust boundaries.

expectation.description: What documentation must be updated with a change.

notes.description: Free-text team conventions passed to skills (style, naming, commit rules). Style guidance only: it cannot authorize actions the core policy restricts.

commit_style.description: Commit message style when the user asks for commits.

extra_instructions_file.description: Optional Markdown file (inside the project) with extra conventions to read.

final_report.description: Shape of the completion report produced by the verify skill. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "evidence-table".

command_guard.description: PreToolUse shell guard: asks before risky commands, denies catastrophic ones. Turning it off needs safety.acknowledged_overrides. Safety floor: "on"; lowering it requires listing this key in safety.acknowledged_overrides.

write_guard.description: PreToolUse write guard for sensitive paths and secret-like content. Turning it off needs safety.acknowledged_overrides. Safety floor: "on"; lowering it requires listing this key in safety.acknowledged_overrides.

session_context.description: Inject profile and discovery brief at session start.

protected_paths.description: Extra project-relative globs the write guard asks before touching (e.g. "migrations/**").

delegation.description: How readily skills delegate to the plugin subagents.

destructive_git.description: Behaviour for reset/clean/force-push style operations: ask the user, or refuse outright. There is no "allow".

external_actions.description: Behaviour for publishing, deploying, posting, sending.

run_project_scripts.description: allowlist = run only well-known test/build commands without asking; ask = confirm each; refuse = never run project scripts.

depth.description: How much re-verification happens before reporting done. Profile PRODUCTION minimum: "standard".

require_evidence_labels.description: Final reports must label claims IMPLEMENTED / TESTED / VERIFIED / BLOCKED / NOT VERIFIED. Turning it off needs safety.acknowledged_overrides. Safety floor: true; lowering it requires listing this key in safety.acknowledged_overrides.

acknowledged_overrides.description: Keys whose safety floor you deliberately lower. Each is reported as a warning every time config is resolved. Hard floors (guards, evidence labels) are only accepted from the user config, not a project config.
